Robert Pattinson will take on the role of James Bond in Amazon MGM's first film in the 007 franchise. The next James Bond film will be directed by Denis Villeneuve using a script written by Steven Knight, while Amy Pascal and David Heyman will produce.

The upcoming James Bond film will be the first from Amazon, which snapped up the rights to the franchise through its acquisition of MGM Studios in 2021. Amazon later gained creative control over the spy series from Barbara Broccoli and Michael G. Wilson in 2025 after a years-long stalemate.
